svg.text: 1. Why and how the default occurred?
for bankruptcy — reactive attempts to access credit.

g.text: Spend spiked to 324K in May 2025 — 2.6× the rolling 12-month median for this account.
Global limit reduced Feb 2025, after two RLI requests were declined — review the approval path.
12 charges at one merchant sit inside the TSR reaction window — 4× this account’s typical frequency.

svg.text: Read together, the three selected pins describe one episode rather than three findings. Spend
breaks from its own baseline in May 2025 (2.6× the rolling median); TSR crosses 20 the following
month and peaks at 27.4 in April; the 12 abnormal charges fall inside that same window. The
sequence — behaviour first, score second, containment third — puts the Feb-2025 limit reduction
downstream of the distress signals, not ahead of them.
Not settled by this data: whether the merchant cluster was deliberate. Needs merchant-side detail.

g.text: Review RLI decline handling before a limit reduction
Two RLI requests were declined for bankruptcy, then the global limit was cut — check the sequencing.
Monitor merchant concentration inside score-reaction windows
12 charges at one merchant clustered in 2025-03 → 2025-06, at 4× the account’s typical frequency.
Early-warning review for single-month TSR breaches
TSR crossed 20 once (27.4, Apr 2025) and reverted — a single breach still preceded the default.
